tasks.description: Project the accepted 052 routine occurrence through the existing owner recommendation GET.
constraints: Accepted source b8ea426. Developer returns a valid unified Git patch in JSON. Use exact current source context around each hunk; the controller applies the diff and runs tests.

Exact additive JSON contract: routine_check = {"rule_id":"UUID","care_revision":2,"due_local_date":"2026-11-23","anchor_local_date":"2026-11-16","anchor_kind":"water"|"check_soil"}. Its due/anchor dates agree with outer next_check.due_on/anchor_on. The core GET contract and source are unchanged.

Use existing production GET and private no-store behavior. Return the additive top-level routine_check unchanged in shape after validating it. For a routine projection use its anchor_local_date and due_local_date for next_check.anchor_on and due_on, and report the last recorded soil check when anchor_kind is check_soil. Continue to return the published interval and provenance, retain EN/PL transport compatibility.

Fail closed if a non-null routine projection has malformed data, inconsistent date arithmetic, or no eligible/calendar-evidenced action. With a missing routine_check, preserve existing watering-derived GET behavior for older DB or initial context. Test successful soil-check anchor, watering anchor, malformed/current evidence and legacy fallback in the existing tests.
Scope is read only. No SQL, write route, iOS, staging, data or reminders.

acceptance_criteria.description: Production Deno entrypoints and diff pass.
HTTP and SQL fixtures verify legacy transport and the published routine date.
